name: llm_triage_ticket
description:
Classifies one support message into a queue (LLM tool, mode classify, model alias fast): billing (invoices, charges, refunds, payment), technical (errors, outages, bugs), account (sign-in, password, profile, access), sales (pricing, plans, quotes) or other. Calls no tools; identical inputs are served from cache.
Returns: label (one of the five), reason (short), confidence (0-1) and stopped_by.
Inputs (* required): message* (the support message text).
Use it to route or tag incoming requests; for a summary of a long message use llm_summarise. An example LLM tool shipped disabled; an administrator enables it.
Example: {"message": "I was charged twice for my March invoice and need a refund."}

llm.system_prompt: billing: invoices, charges, refunds, payment. technical: errors, outages, bugs, the product not working. account: sign-in, password, profile, access. sales: pricing, plans, quotes, buying. other: anything else.
